task.target_gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (sm_120)

capture.cookbook_command: python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path <snap> --trust-remote-code --tp-size 1 --disable-radix-cache --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --max-running-requests 8 --cuda-graph-max-bs 8 --mamba-ssm-dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-draft-model-path RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-0811-DSpark-Stage2 --speculative-dspark-block-size 8
capture.measured_share: GDN verify family ~5.3% of the DSpark verify step (gating update 2.6% + qkvzba split 1.4% + conv update 1.3%), sequential in draft length

benchmark.timing: triton.testing.do_bench around a captured CUDA graph, L2 cold, interleaved A/B

qwen38_gdn_gating_update.note: the same test asserts the conv state with rtol=0, atol=0 (line 209) - the conv half is exact, only the SSM half carries tolerance.

qwen38_qkvzba_split.note: A quantizer's outputs are packed nibbles and e4m3 scale blocks, and a split/reshape/cat only moves bytes: any difference is a different encoding, not rounding. Bit-exact or wrong.

qwen38_conv1d_update.note: bf16 branch is the one these rows hit (silu activation).

correctness.policy: rtol/atol are copied from SGLang's own test for each kernel (source cited per op). Do not loosen them in a task; if a tolerance is wrong, fix it upstream and re-copy.
notes: `qwen38_conv1d_update` is reshaped to the multiple-token form x=[1, dim, T] in RECONSTRUCT; six speculative-decode arguments were not captured and are not reconstructed, so this row models a fully-accepted verify window. See docs/capture_gaps.md.
